inputs.selection_rule: each gamma/lognormal x seed0,1,2; exact saved outer IDs0..199; no endpoint-based selection

input_contract: accepted M05 saved originals only, outer0..199 fixed before inspecting endpoints/warnings/sample skewness; accepted git blobs/local file hashes/all selected hashes and sorted IDs verified; no mother-sample generation or sample standardization
reuse_disclosure: designers know M05 aggregate results; this is reuse of an accepted saved panel, not an unused independent replication; no mixing of M05 inner0 or updating/pooling M05 C/T conclusions

randomness.prefix: one length4999 mean vector per saved original/inner; first999 shared; percentile and BCa share means; recompute each prefix z0/q; prepare t/a/se once per original
randomness.independence: G/L are independent original groups; only B/method differences within the same original are paired; K/B are not population sample counts

inference: accepted ddof1 t, linear quantiles, half-tie z0, delete-one jackknife acceleration and BCa validity rules unchanged; no truth/population parameters passed to inference; no fallback/clipping/adaptive B; tau<10 warns without exclusion

metrics.lower_sd: within-original SD of K30 lower endpoints,ddof1
metrics.upper_sd: within-original SD of K30 upper endpoints,ddof1
metrics.interpretation: finiteK30 operational endpoint-computation variability, not bootstrap-mean SD/estimator SE/RMSE/unbiased ideal conditional SD; never pool endpoints across originals to compute SD
metrics.t_control: t broadcast over B/K is deterministic: endpoint SD/S/Ase/Apop/Vse0, actual valid interval count is R not R*K; M05 K1 stability stays NA
metrics.coverage: C=mean_k I(lower<=0<=upper),Mbelow=mean_k I(upper<0),Mabove=mean_k I(lower>0),T=Mbelow-Mabove; descriptive reused-subpanel only, no M05 C/T retest
metrics.summaries: within-original quantities first; R200 per seed/N600 per population; mean/SD/MCSE/99% original-level t intervals, no clipping, zero variance bounds undefined
metrics.quantiles: p05,p25,p50,p75,p95 linear over independent original metrics, for every recorded metric; no trimming/winsorization
metrics.ratio: mean(Ase4999)/mean(Ase999), never mean of individual ratios

confirmation.H1: BCa B4999 meanAse(lognormal)-meanAse(gamma), independent Welch99%, N600/group. lo>.01 or hi<-.01 =>practical-difference supported; strict inside(-.01,.01)=>not_supported+equivalence_supported; otherwise touching/straddling=>inconclusive. .01 is sample-SE-normalized endpoint variability, NOT1pp
confirmation.H2: per population D=Ase4999-.75*Ase999 on same original, mean t99%,N600. upper<0=>supported; lower>=0=>not_supported; otherwise inconclusive; overall supported iff both supported, not_supported if either not_supported, else inconclusive
confirmation.interpretation: model-based approximate original-level intervals for IID originals selected by fixed ID, including finiteK30 noise; not intervals conditional solely on these1200 fixed samples and inner randomness; approximate Bonferroni noncoverage sum~<=3%, no exact finite-sample guarantee
confirmation.limits: B4999 is not true/infiniteB endpoint; stability reduction does not prove improved coverage/unbiasedness; limited averageAse equivalence does not guarantee individual stability or isolate kurtosis/tail/support cause

invalid_policy: any required invalid K interval or se<=0 makes that method/B original primary metrics NA; required target missing/invalid=>main NA/inconclusive with planned denominators retained; unrelated methods/B do not poison complete targets; conditional_ references with explicit finite counts never decide

storage.samples: all1200 originalfloat64, sample_sha256S64 ASCII hash of little-endian float64 C-order bytes, outer_iduint16, inner_iduint8
storage.endpoints: float64 numeric diagnostics, boolean valid/tail_warning, uint8reason_codes indexing U96reason_labels; full t broadcast stored with R-only aggregation
storage.stream_schema: indicesuint8(4999,20) reversible from nativeint64 RNG indices, meansfloat64(4999), inputhash/IDs/meta; first999 prefix; only18 preregistered streams stored
storage.audit_scope: all endpoint-derived metrics/tables/decisions plus exact indices->means/prefix/rank/a/linear endpoints for18 selected streams; never claim complete reconstruction of all36000 generation sequences
storage.estimate_caveat: conservative allocation not guaranteed compression; actual guards stop without scientific resizing; no storage of other full bootstrap/index arrays

execution.main: once only; root executes guarded CLI, no ordinary pytest/UI/audit launch
execution.smoke: sole separately authorized6cells/savedouter0,1/K2/B99 in separate namespace;12savedoriginals,24streams,2376resamples, no mother generation or scientific selection
execution.guard: worker294softstop,parentTERM295/KILL298/finish target299, full external CLI cap300; cleanup ignores repeated TERM
execution.correction: actual code bug only, at most one separately authorized attempt retaining reason/oldsource/results, cumulative mainwall<=600; no redraw on outcome/invalid/timeout
execution.stop: preserve complete and observed partial panels/records/stream diagnostics; no automatic shrinking or ID/R/K/B changes
